'''M2934738 system''' was a sparse [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], its only distinction being that it was on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between [[Liinade III]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], it was the site of the [[Battle of M2934738]].
